citation.authors: Wise MK, Brookes JJ, Wu T, Peterson M et al

cited_by.title: Heavy periods by life stage and cause

record.population: 638 endometrial cancer survivors (36% Black or African American), Carolina Endometrial Cancer Study, US
record.finding: Women with fibroids were more likely to report heavy periods (prevalence ratio 1.23) and periods over 7 days (1.37). After adjusting for age, fibroids and BMI, symptoms did not vary by race. Only 23% knew bleeding after menopause could be a sign of endometrial cancer.
record.note: People who already had cancer, so it says nothing about how often heavy periods mean cancer.
